verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust/Axum web framework, and a framework could plausibly ship background jobs or scheduled automations, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents no capability for setting up autonomous background automations, recurring schedules, or background job execution. The dev-server auto-restart on file changes and AGENTS.md guidance for coding agents are adjacent features, not user-configurable autonomous automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
